result.title: Vibe-Trading: Towards Agent-Native Trading
result.comment: Technical report. 16 pages, 8 figures, 4 tables. Code: https://github.com/HKUDS/Vibe-Trading
result.summary: Existing AI agents can retrieve information, call tools, run experiments, and produce multi-step outputs. Yet most are built around relatively static workflows and struggle to preserve reliable state as the environment changes. Financial trading makes this limitation especially consequential: prices, news, market conditions, portfolio positions, and available capital evolve continuously. A result is useful only when it remains tied to the correct time, data snapshot, and execution context. We present Vibe-Trading, a comprehensive agent-native trading framework and all-in-one workspace for building, evaluating, and evolving agents for financial trading. It unifies market research, financial data, strategy generation, backtesting, portfolio analysis, paper trading, multi-agent collaboration, and optional broker execution. Its central contribution is an architecture that keeps results, evidence, research history, and trading authority connected throughout the research-to-action process. Each result retains its source, temporal scope, configuration, and producing run. Shared evidence grounding enables verification, versioned research records support reproducible continuation, and an explicit authority gate separates strategy research from live execution. Together, these designs provide a practical foundation for trading agents whose results can be traced, reproduced, and acted on only under explicit authority.

AI.brief_summary: 提出一个面向金融交易的 agent 原生框架与一体化工作区，统一市场研究、策略生成、回测、组合分析、模拟交易与可选券商执行；核心是让结果、证据、研究历史和交易权限在整个「研究到行动」过程中保持绑定、可追溯和可复现。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「结果绑定来源、时间范围与产生运行 + 共享证据校验 + 显式授权门控」的溯源设计，可供核查 LVR 中证据筛选、状态版本化更新与停止/行动决策的记录与验证机制，但属较远领域且不涉及视觉推理。
